mapper.sql: o.*, s.name AS store_name, s.platform, w.name AS warehouse_name, ch.name AS channel_name, (SELECT so.platform_order_no FROM ecom_order so WHERE so.id = o.source_order_id) AS source_order_no, (SELECT ec.name FROM ecom_logistics_channel ec WHERE ec.id = o.est_channel_id) AS est_channel_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecom_order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id) AS item_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pi.package_id) FROM ecom_package_item pi JOIN ecom_package p ON p.id = pi.package_id WHERE pi.order_id = o.id AND p.status <> 'CANCELLED') AS package_count

sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_order_tag_link tl WHERE tl.order_id = o.id AND tl.tag_id = #{q.tagId})
AND o.ship_by < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND o.local_status IN ('PENDING', 'ON_HOLD', 'EXCEPTION', 'OUT_OF_STOCK', 'AUDITED', 'LABELED', 'OUTBOUND', 'PARTIAL')

AND (o.platform_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR o.buyer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR o.ship_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR o.tracking_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id AND oi.seller_sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_package_item pi JOIN ecom_package p ON p.id = pi.package_id WHERE pi.order_id = o.id AND (p.package_no = #{q.keyword} OR p.tracking_no = #{q.keyword})))

mapper.sql: FROM ecom_order o JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = o.store_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN ecom_logistics_channel ch ON ch.id = o.channel_id
mapper.select:
SELECT o.local_status AS "localStatus", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM ecom_order o JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = o.store_id
GROUP BY o.local_status
SELECT o.* FROM ecom_order o WHERE o.id IN #{id} ORDER BY o.id FOR UPDATE
